essence: The enumerated śaktis are Kamalā, Kitavā, Viśvā, and Vividhā.
The powers are identified with Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, and the subsequent zodiac signs.
Viśvā is characterized as devouring, all-consuming, and of manifold origin.
The unthinkable goddess praised by Bhava has the world-guardians before her.
The practice requires one hundred thousand mantra repetitions and a one-tenth ghee oblation.
